policy.preserve: Worker-authored reports/proofs/scripts/compact results/receipts/corrections, relevant histories, explicitly sourced compact numeric replay inputs and license notices.
policy.exclude: Installed environments/dependencies, source repositories, copied publisher code, complete papers/SI/figures/web copies, raw archives/extraction trees and >5MB derived rows.
policy.root_synthesis: Separate final evidence/root packet copied only on root's final signal.
policy.source_licenses: Retained source notices do not by themselves settle license scope of every numeric extract; source metadata/receipts remain authoritative and any unresolved scope is explicit.
